question: Should compact skills prompts spend remaining budget on shortened descriptions after preserving all name/location/version identities?
rationale: This is a model-visible prompt tradeoff for large skill catalogs; tests prove the implementation shape, but CI cannot decide whether this prompt-budget behavior should become the product default.

options.title: Accept with real prompt proof
options.body: Require redacted after-fix prompt output or maintainer proof, then proceed if the output preserves identities and uses leftover budget as intended.

options.title: Accept with maintainer override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the prompt tradeoff without contributor proof, but that should be recorded as proof override before merge.

options.title: Pause for truncation strategy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the broader omitted-key or prioritization work to define the compact prompt strategy first.

recommendation.title: Accept with real prompt proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted after-fix prompt output or maintainer proof, then proceed if the output preserves identities and uses leftover budget as intended.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned and authored the refreshed head, and current history shows recent work on the affected skills prompt files.
